Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk has been placed under a 60-day house arrest in Ladakh and barred from participating in public rallies. The move comes amid protests against the December 4 hill council elections, with local leaders warning that harsh winter conditions and seasonal migration could disenfranchise voters.
